instagram.caption:
The game with one piece missing.
The Board Game and Puzzle Zone in the Family Room. Store games and puzzles so that anything you pull off the shelf is complete and playable tonight.

What done looks like:
1. Boxes lying flat in stacks no more than five high
2. Each with a strip of tape on the short edge naming the game so you can read it from the doorway
3. Every loose piece bagged inside its own lid
4. Not one box on the shelf that failed its count

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success board game and puzzle zone.
